documents.title: Financial Results For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Board Meeting Outcome For Submission Of Unaudited Financial Results For Quarter Ended September 30, 2026, Along With Limited Review Report
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of Unaudited (Consolidated And Standalone ) Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.

analysis.summary: Aryaman Financial Services Limited presented its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, highlighting its operational performance as a SEBI-registered Category I Merchant Banker. On a standalone basis, total income reached Rs. 1,751.34 lakh and net profit rose to Rs. 689.55 lakh, while consolidated total income stood at Rs. 8,440.58 lakh with a net profit of Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: The management stated that the SME IPO market witnessed broad-based participation from enterprises across India during the year, with issuances originating from 21 cities.
demand_outlook.quote: The SME IPO market witnessed broad-based participation from enterprises across India during the year, with issuances originating from 21 cities.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that Mumbai continued to be the dominant center, followed by New Delhi, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, and Nashik.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai continued to be the dominant center, followed by New Delhi, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, and Nashik.

demand_outlook.claim: The company reported that the SME IPO market witnessed healthy participation across a broad spectrum of industries during the year.
demand_outlook.quote: The SME IPO market witnessed healthy participation across a broad spectrum of industries during the year, highlighting the increasing adoption of capital markets by businesses from diverse sectors.

orders_capacity.claim: The company completed 4 SME IPOs and 2 Main Board IPOs during the financial year 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote: We successfully completed 4 SME IPOs and 2 Main Board IPO in the Financial Year 2024-25, further solidifying our position in the market.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to transfer any amount to the Reserves for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has decided not to transfer any amount to the Reserves for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The Directors do not recommend any dividend for the year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: the Directors do not recommend any dividend for the year ended March 31, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: In the financial year 2025-26, there was no amount due for transfer to the Investor Education and Protection Fund.
capital_allocation.quote: In the financial year 2025-26, there was no amount due for transfer to IEPF.

capital_allocation.claim: Members' approval is sought to borrow up to Rs. 100 Crores through loans, overdraft facilities, lines of credit, or debentures.
capital_allocation.quote: provided that the total amount so borrowed by the Board shall not at any time exceed Rs. 100 Crores (Rupees Hundred Crores only) or equivalent amount in any other foreign currency.

management_commitments.claim: M/s. JNG & Co. LLP is appointed as Secretarial Auditors for a second term of 5 consecutive years commencing from Financial Year 2025-26 till Financial Year 2029-30.
management_commitments.quote: M/s. JNG & Co. LLP., Practicing Company Secretaries (Firm Registration No.: L2024MH017500), be and is hereby appointed as Secretarial Auditors of the Company for the second term of 5 (five) consecutive years, commencing from the Financial Year 2025-26 till Financial Year 2029-30

management_commitments.claim: Remuneration for Whole-Time Director Mr. Shripal Shah is increased up to ₹84 Lakhs per annum effective from April 01, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: consent of the members of the company be and is hereby accorded for an increase in the payment of remuneration of Mr. Shripal Shah (DIN: 01628855), Whole time Director up to ₹ 84 Lakhs per annum (inclusive of salary, perquisites, benefits, incentives and allowances) w.e.f. April 01, 2025 up to his remaining tenure

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to aligning its growth with broader economic and financial sector trends while prioritizing client service excellence, regulatory compliance, and innovation.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we are committed to aligning our growth with broader economic and financial sector trends. We will continue to prioritize client service excellence, regulatory compliance, and innovation.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
